verifications.source_context: Expression of cell-typical (INS for b-cells, GCG for a-cells) and non-typical hormone in cells, ranked by transcriptional noise. Cell identity is indicated by marker gene expression.
verifications.reason: 作者明确将 INS 作为 b-cells 的 cell-typical marker，并在图 1A 中说明 cell identity is indicated by marker gene expression，表明其实际用于细胞类型识别/注释。旧排除理由仅为不在目标细胞范围，按复核口径不构成排除理由。
